summary:
Implementation Plan for Project Nova:
- Purges all Persona 3 game lore, Atlus characters, tarot arcana, Japanese subtitles, and moon cycles
- Retains and elevates the signature game UI aesthetic from the reference image: vivid oceanic azure, water caustics, submerged audio cord / floating bubble motif, slanted kinetic typography, and angular glass HUD
- Implements the complete Project Nova Hackathon Brief:
  1. Accounts, authentication & shareable public profile (/u/{handle}) with prominent copy-link control
  2. Four stats (Academics, Vitality, Culture, Memories) on the unified rank curve (0/12/30/55/90 XP)
  3. Academics study engine with custom user resource syllabus + strict resource-grounded AI teacher generating outlines, diagrams, and interactive 5-question quizzes
  4. Vitality conditioning engine with session logs + Health & Sports Coach covering workouts, sleep, rest, and athletic recovery
  5. Culture deck with category Top-10 rankings (Anime, Manga, Movies, Series, Games, Books) + 5-item AI taste recommender
  6. Memories photographic archive granting 3 XP per upload with captioning
  7. Culture Interest Match & Chat deck with PASS/CONNECT actions, LINKED celebratory stamp, and instant messaging with pre-seeded demo users for solo demonstration
